Description:
This variable shows the average temperature in Fahrenheit taken on July 28th, 2023, for each census tract. Here, temperature refers to the ambient air temperature.

The values for temperature were measured in one day during a community mapping initiative, where participants used specialized equipment to measure temperature along set routes throughout the city. Each route was designed to take measurements along a diverse set of environments and land uses. Then, sampling the data from each route with land cover satellite data, an AI model was used to create predictive surface models for the entire city, creating models for morning, afternoon, and evening, as well as an average model, which is what can be seen here.

Economic hardship is measured as a composite index from six measures: unemployment, dependency, education, income, crowded housing, poverty. This index measure compares economic conditions between communities in a more comprehensive way than a single measure could. We followed the original formulation by Nathan and Adams (1976) and use ACS 2018 data (5-year estimate) to calculate.

For more details, please revie: Nathan, R. P., & Adams, C. (1976). Understanding central city hardship. Political science quarterly, 91(1), 47-62.
